stages.label: History
stages.text: 71-year-old with end-stage knee arthritis. Six months of supervised therapy, weight loss, and two injections have not helped. Pain limits walking to one block.

stages.label: Imaging report
stages.text: Bone-on-bone medial and patellofemoral arthritis with varus deformity.

stages.label: Pre-operative exam
stages.text: Draining open wound with surrounding redness over the anterior knee, present for two weeks.

guideline.note: Not now: an active soft-tissue infection at the operative site must be treated before elective arthroplasty.

attending.note: Postpone; treat the wound, then reassess.
